name: Aanisho (The instant publish plugin for wordpress)
author: saeedj94

sections.description:
workes for panel.publica.ir sites Publica Instantly publishes reportages from panel dashboard and reportage editor while completing content from customer panel. just by installing this plugin in publisher wordpress website.

Installation Guide

  1. download the .zip package from “https://wordpress.org/plugins/aanishow/”

  2. install the package in wordpress plugins by uploading method

  3. in the settinga page of aanisho plugin , which automatically opens , just select reportage plan which you want to sync the instant publish
